# Preface {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-warning}
The grammarly of the content may have some mistakes.
:::

This handbook is mainly for the beginner of the bioinformatics. It is better to understand the basic concepts of the computer and molecular biology before reading this book.

This book is still developing, maybe some of the contents will be wrong. Use with caution.

## What this book main for {#sec-what-this-book-main-for}

This is the very basic introduction for the beginners, if you are not very familiar with the computer science, I think this will help you to start more easier. 

## About the author
The author, me, is just the student who start for learning bioinformatics, with the molecular wet-lab backgroud. During learning, I found that there is hardly the whole free source for the biginner to learn the very basic bioinfo, such as how to operate the Linux/Unix system, how to setup the remote connection in one book. 

Therefore, I want to write the book, which can make the people who have no basic but need to use bioinformatic, can get started quickly.

::: {.callout-note}
I am the Traditional Chinese native speaker, while want to use English to write due that the international people can understand easily, so maybe some grammar may have some mistake.
:::
